# Make it Squeaky

> Residential cleaning in Toronto, run by Tiffany Wells. Over a decade of professional cleaning experience, one set of hands on every job — no crews, no subcontractors. Regular, deep, move-in/move-out, and post-renovation cleaning, priced instantly from square footage.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://makeitsqueaky.com/): Overview of the business, service list, and the fastest path to a quote.
- [Get Your Price](https://makeitsqueaky.com/quote.html): Instant quote calculator — service type, postal code, square footage (or a bedroom/bathroom estimate), add-ons, and a few condition questions produce a live price.
- [Services](https://makeitsqueaky.com/services.html): What's included in each of the four cleaning types.
- [Pricing](https://makeitsqueaky.com/pricing.html): Per-square-foot rates, add-on prices, the minimum job, and travel fees.
- [About](https://makeitsqueaky.com/about.html): Background on Tiffany and how the business operates.
- [Contact](https://makeitsqueaky.com/contact.html): Phone number and a link to start a quote online.
- [Policies](https://makeitsqueaky.com/policies.html): Deposit, cancellation, service area, and standard-clean scope.

## Key Facts

- Service area: City of Toronto (all M postal codes) at no travel fee; inner and outer GTA available for a travel fee.
- Travel fees: City of Toronto no fee, inner GTA $35, outer GTA $60. Derived from the postal code, and added after the minimum job price rather than absorbed by it.
- Services: Regular Cleaning ($0.25/sq ft, half-day), Deep Cleaning ($0.40/sq ft, full-day), Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning ($0.65/sq ft, full-day), Post-Renovation Cleaning ($0.75/sq ft, full-day).
- Pricing basis: quoted by approximate square footage, or estimated from home type, bedrooms, and bathrooms if the exact figure isn't known.
- Minimum job price: $180 CAD. Small jobs are floored at this minimum, not billed at the raw per-square-foot rate.
- Add-ons: inside oven ($50) and inside refrigerator ($50) are fixed. Interior windows are $10 per window. Inside cabinets and drawers and wall washing start from $75 each, and inside kitchen appliances starts from $25 per appliance — those three are starting prices, confirmed after a look.
- Quoted individually, with no starting price: heavy grime or excessive buildup, heavy pet hair, and heavy construction residue.
- Jobs with heavy grime buildup, unusually heavy pet hair, or recent construction residue are not priced automatically — Tiffany confirms these in person so the price is right the first time.
- Currency: CAD. No online payment in this phase — quotes are followed up by phone or message.
- Contact: phone/text at +1 (416) 564-2125, or email tiffanypoerazoff10@gmail.com.
